Directives:
 Identification of GIS Internal Components

sections.text:
This documents details the directives for GIS Internal Component is prepared
using 
 IEC
 617-7 May, 1996
the first revision was at 
 06 Feb 2002

items:
In order to make the identification of internal parts of GIS
 equipment simple and error free, it is recommended to paint, or through the
 application of tape, the symbols of the station single line diagram on the
 outside of the pipe work .

Only standard symbols must be used for circuit breakers,
 switching resisters, Capacitors, disconnect switches, earthing switches,
 potential transformers, current transformers, incoming lines and outgoing
 feeders .

The different SF6 pressures for bus compartments and
 interrupter compartments must also be identified on both sides of internal
 closed pipe cones. Gas envelopes containing all 3-bus phases should also be
 clearly marked.
Use fiberglass ladders to climb GIS switchgear.
Do not step on control cables, piping or pressure gauges.
Carefully clean the pipe work before applying paint or tape

Use pencil or marker pen to outline the single line diagram
 with its individual components.

Line thickness should be a minimum of 20 mm and a maximum of
 30 mm.

If using paint, use masking tape or cardboard templates to
 prevent paint runs

Use only the Standard Symbols according to IEC
 617-7 May, 1996 as in the next
